Alright, let me teach you a trick here. Take your cutlets to the next level. We call this crack chicken. So what you got is you got a normal chicken cutlet, but when you beat it down or use your tortilla press, put a little prosciutto de parma in there. Now what we got is we got a layer of prosciutto that's about to go so crazy when we make this into our final cutlet here. Just watch. Pull them. Don't forget, there's a nice thin layer of prosciutto. Hit them while they're still hot. A little bit of salt. Yuck.
